title: The Lord's Redemption of Zion
description: The Lord calls Zion and Jerusalem to wake up, shake off the dust, and put on strength, for He promises to redeem His people without silver. A messenger proclaims peace and salvation over the mountains: Your God reigns as King! The Lord reveals His holy arm to all nations, and the people are called to go out in peace and purity, with the Lord Himself leading them from the front and protecting them from behind.
